titleJa: ワンシーズンのおなじみさん
artBrief: **Autumn Japan.** A welcoming study room framed by a glowing maple branch, with a lantern and an open book. Seasonal atmosphere is decorative, not a calendar restriction.

request.description: One original collectible achievement illustration for a language-learning app, native 128x128 pixel art, opaque square environmental scene. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, clean readable silhouettes, restrained 32-color palette. A single strong focal subject should remain identifiable at 64x64. Fill the canvas but keep the main subject within an 8-pixel safe margin. No badge frame, lettering, numbers, readable text, logos or watermarks; no photorealism, blur or smooth vector art. Autumn Japan. A welcoming study room framed by a glowing maple branch, with a lantern and an open book. Seasonal atmosphere is decorative, not a calendar restriction. Warm Japanese study room through a large wooden window framed by one red-orange maple branch. One prominent open book and glowing paper lantern, amber and deep indigo, restful fall atmosphere.

style_image.usage_description: Copy only pixel cluster scale, crisp edge handling and shading discipline. Do not copy the reference scene, objects, layout or palette. Follow the new scene brief. Where a white fox is requested, preserve its pointed ears, muzzle and fluffy tail.
